name: RobotInteract Target Generation
description: Controlled multi-reference cases for selecting a teacher model to synthesize affective human-robot interaction target images.

prompt.en: Create a photorealistic full-body photograph. The adult woman from the first reference image (ref_image_0) stands on the left, and the white-and-orange biped humanoid robot from the second reference image (ref_image_1) stands on the right. Strictly preserve the woman's identity, blue jacket, white shirt and charcoal trousers, and preserve the robot's white-orange colors, black face panel, two cyan circular eyes, head, torso, exactly two mechanical arms, two hands and two legs.
